title: The Last Jedi Standing
front_description: The titanic struggle between Jedi Masters Yoda and Dooku continues. Finally, their blades cross and the fighting slows. "Fought well you have, my old Padawan," observes Yoda. "This battle is just the beginning," the Count sneers, glancing at a crane in the hangar. With that, Dooku uses the Force to send the crane crashing toward downed Obi-Wan and Anakin. Instantly, Yoda comes to their rescue. Then wily Dooku takes advantage of this distraction and races to his solar sailer.
back_description: A digital rendering of Jedi Master Yoda.
